items.prompt: A proposed rewrite uses state + alpha*(price-state). What is needed before treating it as identical to this public floating contract?

options.why: Real-arithmetic equivalence does not establish identical floating results; the public contract fixes the expression order.

options.text: Use integer division for alpha to remove all rounding.
options.why: Integer division would give zero for many spans and change the algorithm completely.

options.text: Round both operands to four decimals before multiplying.
options.why: The public contract formats only output and keeps full internal floating state.

options.text: Assume every algebraic rearrangement is bit-identical.
options.why: Finite-precision intermediate results can differ even for algebraically equal formulas.

items.explanation: Real-arithmetic equivalence does not establish identical floating results; the public contract fixes the expression order.
